row.team_price_text: Rankings: custom pricing based on number of keyword search queries
row.evidence: seoClarity's security page lists 'Single-sign on (SSO) SAML 2.0' and Okta's OIN app is SAML only; neither the pricing page nor any public page mentions SCIM, and the knowledge base (kb.seoclarity.net) returns 403 to public requests.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Enterprise SEO platform sold by custom quote: Rankings (custom, unlimited users), Research & Content (starts at $2,500/month), Technical SEO (starts at $3,200/month), Enterprise (starts at $4,500/month); the page says prices are representative as of October 11, 2022 and priced by domains and keywords, so per-user fields are null. SAML 2.0 SSO is advertised but its plan is not stated. No SCIM, provisioning or user-management API is documented on public pages; the Zoho knowledge base that would hold admin docs is not publicly readable, so the status stays unknown rather than none. Data APIs (ranking, keyword research, content analysis) are SEO data APIs, not user management.

user_api.notes: Pricing page lists 'API and BI Tools Integration' for SEO data (RedShift, BigQuery, Data Studio); no user-management API is documented publicly.

fallbacks.notes: docs_public left null: kb.seoclarity.net (Zoho Desk) returns 403 to WebFetch and its search API answers UNAUTHORIZED, render.cjs fails with ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES, so whether admin docs are public or login-only could not be confirmed.
